t: This is 12 Downing Street, one of the buildings on Downing Street in Westminster. It is traditionally the office of the Chief Whip, while its upper floor forms part of the prime minister's residential apartment. The Crown has owned and used it since 1803, first for the Judge Advocate General and then the Colonial Office. The Chief Whip's office moved in during 1879. Herbert Gladstone was born here. He was the youngest son of William Ewart Gladstone, and went on to be Home Secretary from 1905 to 1910.
